qualification: Source contract only; compiled native and real first-request acceptance are required.

semantics.source_url: preserve explicit URL port and path; derive a source URL only for domain-form cookies
semantics.explicit_path: preserved; missing path uses CanonicalCookie native default-path rules
semantics.secure: explicit boolean preserved; omitted defaults to false
semantics.domain: explicit domain attribute; URL form is host-only
semantics.session: expires omitted or -1 maps to empty native Time
semantics.persistent: nonnegative finite Unix seconds, including 0 as expired deletion; native expiry bounds apply

lifecycle.owner: eager ProfileKeyedService for regular original Default only
lifecycle.navigation_gate: NavigationThrottleRegistry waits for receipt publication; failure cancels navigation
lifecycle.completion: all SetCanonicalCookie statuses included, Flush acknowledged, GetAllCookies exact readback, atomic receipt published
lifecycle.shared_deadline: envelope.deadlineUnixMs binds this attempt; after the deadline no navigation resumes, even if a late completion ledger is retained for later recovery
lifecycle.previous_completion: one-shot token ledger; do not reimport session cookies after completion

receipt.partial_failure: partialApplied and writeOutcomeUnknown; rollbackPerformed is false
